summary.text: Sally Ann Gonzales is a Democratic member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 20 who is running in 2026 for the Arizona House of Representatives in District 20 rather than seeking re-election to the Senate.
She previously served in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2011 to 2019 and has been a state senator since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Gonzales earned a master's degree in education from the University of Arizona in 1995.
She served on the Pascua Yaqui Tribal Council from 1992 to 1998 and has served as president of the Guadalupe Community Development Corporation.
Gonzales represented House District 3 from 2011 to 2019 and has served in the state Senate since 2019, with her current term ending on January 11, 2027.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Senate Health and Human Services Committee and the Senate Military Affairs and Border Security Committee.
